prompts.name: icon-dark
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Input image is the edit target: selected Zephyr branding board. Produce one individual production PNG asset, 1024x1024 square, with genuine transparent alpha background. Extract and faithfully reconstruct only the specified element, preserving its exact flowing Z silhouette, curvature, proportions, pointed tips, angle, material and colors. No board, words, letters other than the emblem Z, labels, wordmarks, other elements or mockups. Extract ONLY the large upper-left charcoal rounded-square macOS app icon with sculptural warm golden copper flowing Z. Keep tile and emblem exactly as reference, frontal view. Center tile at 82% canvas width and height, outer 9% margins fully transparent, no cast shadow or glow outside tile. Keep internal dimensional shading and slim copper rim.

Do not redesign, add shadows, add tile, or add text. Return a single clean transparent PNG.
cleanup.markDarkFinal: Use case: background-extraction. Remove this image's checkerboard and make it GENUINELY TRANSPARENT using an alpha channel. Output a single PNG with actual transparent background, no other changes, no added noise or stray pixels.
